en: Multiview color postcard titled "Băile Tușnad," showing the Romanian spa resort in the forested Eastern Carpathians: an aerial view of the town around a small lake, a crater lake surrounded by woods, modern resort buildings and a lakeside pavilion. The reverse has Romanian text ("Carte poștală"), an Editura Meridiane imprint, a blue POSTA ROMANA 40 BANI stamp with cancellation, and a handwritten message and address to Constanța.
